blurb:
Join Mint Julep Experiences for an unforgettable journey to Lynchburg, where the legacy of Jack Daniel's Tennessee whiskey comes to life. Enjoy time in Lynchburg’s historic square for shopping and Southern cuisine before your guided tour. 

Exclusive to Mint Julep: During your free time, enjoy a complimentary bonus tasting at Company Distilling! Drop in for a pour of their flagship Straight Bourbon Whiskey finished with maple wood. (Extra tastings available for a fee. Note: Self-guided, subject to hours, closed Mondays).

Itinerary

Depart Nashville: Pickup near Rep. John Lewis Way S. at 9:45 am; depart 10:00 am.
Explore Lynchburg: 1.5 hours for lunch, shopping & exclusive Company Distilling tasting.
Tour Distillery: ~1.5-hour elevated Jack Daniel's tasting.
Return: Arrive in Nashville ~5:00 pm.

Highlights
Elevated tasting at Jack Daniel’s Distillery
Mint Julep Exclusive: Bonus Company Distilling tasting
Sample single barrel & limited-edition whiskeys
Learn Tennessee whiskey history
